intro: At the Tower of Azora, Archmage Theocritus leads a scholarly outpost in eastern Elwynn Forest. The slender spire stands north of the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, where its human master keeps watch over a silent magical feud with a hostile tower in the Redridge Mountains.

p: The Tower of Azora stands beside the eastern road to the Redridge Mountains, staffed almost entirely by gnome spellcasters. Archmage Theocritus guides their studies of strange curiosities and teaches wandering spellweavers. A wild magical aura surrounds the spire and sometimes warps nearby wildlife. Within the tower, gnome servants contend with enchanted household items and mutated insects that creep past the doorway.
